name: Enshou
source: Head of the Yuan family, a proud and renowned family. She is a selfish, high-spirited, and proud young lady. She is the leader of the anti-taku alliance, but due to her arrogant and irreverent personality, she is unable to lead the generals in various regions and is having a hard time against the Toutaku forces.
